title: The supervisor is the top hotspot and half of it is untested

AC1.note: tests/unit/supervisor-loops.test.ts declares each expected interval with its count and asserts them exactly; a missing loop fails. Lower bounds were the first review finding and are gone

AC2.note: same file: every registered timer asserted unref'd, both before and after the offset timeouts run

AC3.note: tests/unit/supervisor-analyst.test.ts — empty, populated, and no section dropped when its list is empty

AC4.note: same file: refused, unreachable and unparseable all degrade rather than throw, with a stubbed fetch

AC5.note: same file: refused, unreachable and unparseable all degrade rather than throw, with a stubbed fetch

AC6.note: checkGemmaHealth and scheduledReviewDeps driven with FakeSql and a stubbed transport in supervisor-gemma-loop.test.ts; checkRecovery deferred — it iterates a module-private map and would need a seam, recorded rather than forced

AC7.note: one production change beyond exports: the startup inventory line, which named seven loops of eleven and then, after the first fix, omitted process_health and named a probe this branch does not have. Named as a defect in the CHANGELOG

AC8.note: scripts/supervisor.ts 52.03% -> 75.60% measured on the branch in a git worktree (263 uncovered); 73.66% in the working tree, which carries another session's untested loop. Both figures recorded in the CHANGELOG and the PR

AC9.note: bun test tests/unit/: 1566 pass 0 fail; bunx tsc --noEmit clean

AC10.note: CHANGELOG.md Unreleased — test: the supervisor's loop inventory is now asserted

AC11.note: reviewer rounds: 3. R1 lower-bound assertions, fixed. R2 the log line omitted process_health, fixed together with the mirror defect it named a probe this branch lacks. R3 repeated the bot-alive point, which is another session's uncommitted loop: verified in an isolated worktree of the branch — zero occurrences, and the inventory test passes there
